metadata.description: Demo subset of experiment art_UkIMstVveAFx (Cheng et al. 2023 ideational consistency on OpenAlex topic co-usage): 100 EXP5 frame concepts stratified by field group and body; transient concepts (O3 == 1) oversampled to 2 per group so that the rare transience outcome varies.
metadata.label: selection data, not confirmation
metadata.per_year_fields: V = grounded yearly volume; topic_ids/topic_counts = HOME-build non-SELF topic co-usage vector v_t; n_papers_topic = HOME papers with >= 1 topic; CONS/CONS_r/EMB/EMB_cos/SOC = stored HOME measures; CONS_all = ALL-build CONS
